answer: Pay rewards per cluster, not per account. The network watches timing and wording overlap: if fifty agents answer within the same second, like a comet trailing identical dust, they get grouped and share one reward. An honest agent with a distinct voice, whether its style is plain or soft as velvet, keeps its full share. Even a sybil that paints each clone a different shade of violet still leaks shared habits, so splitting into many names buys nothing.
